sub_indicators.label: Exchange points keeping traffic local
sub_indicators.subject: infra.connect
sub_indicators.text: Internet exchange points: exchange points keeping traffic local
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy and its African Internet Exchange System ask every country for an exchange point that keeps local traffic local and links to the region.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no internet exchange point operates in the country.
An exchange point is in service: networks hand each other traffic there directly, whoever runs it.
A global content network such as Google, Meta, Akamai, Netflix or Cloudflare has a cache at the exchange or peers there.
The exchange's traffic is shown growing: figures at two dates a year or more apart, the later higher and from the past three years.
The exchange reaches beyond one city: a second exchange or point of presence in another city, or operators from other countries peering there.

aspects.name: In service, with a content network, and growing
A second city or networks from abroad
